say:2:1720320001:1.text: My dear friend. I drink to you, and to all who gave their lives for the Lightbearer Empire.
say:2:1720320001:1.source_cn: 我的挚友。这杯酒，为你，也为所有为耀光献身的人们。

say:3:1720320002:1.text: The empire has at last been set upon its proper course. My duty... is done.
say:3:1720320002:1.source_cn: 帝国已经走上了正轨，我的使命……也已经完成。

say:4:1720320003:1.text: I hear Dura calling. I must follow where she leads, to a place no mortal can reach.
say:4:1720320003:1.source_cn: 艾雅女神的呼唤，我已听见。我将追随她的指引，前往那凡人...

say:5:1720320004:1.text: Your Majesty... are you leaving us?
say:5:1720320004:1.source_cn: 大帝……你要离开我们了吗……

say:6:1720320005:1.text: Before I go, there is one last thing.
say:6:1720320005:1.source_cn: 临别之前，尚有最后一事——

say:7:1720320006:1.text: By Dura's will, the sacred sword shall rest in stone. Until it is drawn, the throne shall remain empty. The one who draws it shall be crowned.
say:7:1720320006:1.source_cn: 奉艾雅之意：圣剑归于磐石，圣剑不出，王座空悬，圣剑出鞘...

say:9:1720320007:1.text: Rolan places the sacred sword, symbol of divine favor and royal authority, into the stone given by Dura. The moment he does, he disappears from sight.
say:9:1720320007:1.source_cn: 罗兰大帝将那柄象征着神恩与王权的圣剑，插入了艾雅赐予的...

say:10:1720320008:1.text: But before he departs, he leaves one final decree: From that day on, the next ruler of the empire will be chosen by the sword, now known as Excalibur.
say:10:1720320008:1.source_cn: 在那之前，他留下了最后的旨意——从今往后，耀光的继承人...

say:11:1720320009:1.text: Only the one accepted by Excalibur may become the next ruler of the Lightbearer Empire. And so that sacred decree is passed down through the generations!
say:11:1720320009:1.source_cn: 唯有被石中剑认可之人，方能成为耀光的新王。这个神圣的仪...
